Daily Quiz.question: ১) We ______ what to do with the money.
Daily Quiz.exp:
Sub+has/have + yet + verb infinitive
We have yet to decide what to do with the money.
John has yet to learn the material.
Source: Cliffs TOEFL, page no: 63

Daily Quiz.question: ২) The number of days in a week ____ seven.
Daily Quiz.exp:
The number of + plural noun + singular verb
The number of days (plural noun) in a week is (singular verb) seven.
Source: Cliffs TOEFL, page no:75

Daily Quiz.question: ৩) Jill is in need of Money. Here 'is in need of' can be transformed into ____.
Daily Quiz.exp:
Sub + be + in need of + noun
Jill is in need of money. (Jill needs money.)
The roof is in need of repair. (The roof needs to be repaired.)
The organization was in need of volunteers. (The organization needed volunteers.)
Source: Cliffs TOEFL, page no: 91

Daily Quiz.question: ৪) We are driving to Atlanta ____ way of Baton Rouge.
Daily Quiz.exp: by way of = so as to pass through or across, via. Source: Cliffs TOEFL, page no: 279

Daily Quiz.question: ৫) While John was reading a book, Maratha ______ television.
Daily Quiz.exp:
While+sub1 + past progressive + sub2 + past progressive.
While John was reading a book, Maratha was watching television.
While+sub1 + past progressive + sub2 + past simple.
While John was reading a book, Maratha watched television.
Source: Cliffs TOEFL, page no: 60

Daily Quiz.question: ৬) The view of these disciplines _____ time to time.
Daily Quiz.exp:
Sub (singular) + prepositional phrase + verb (singular).
The view (singular subject) of these disciplines (prepositional phrase) varies from (singular verb) time to time.
Source: Cliffs TOEFL, page no: 69

Daily Quiz.question: ৭) Maria went to the store because she was out _____ milk.
Daily Quiz.exp: out of+noun = to lack, to be without. Source: Cliffs TOEFL, page no: 278

Daily Quiz.question: ৮) Mr. Robbins, accompanied by his wife & children, ______ tonight.
Daily Quiz.exp:
together with, along with, accompanied by & as well as have no effect on the verb. So the singular subject (Mr. Robbins) will take a singular verb (is arriving).
Source: Cliffs TOEFL, page no: 70 & 71

Daily Quiz.question: ৯) _____ cordial ____ one of his greatest assets.
Daily Quiz.exp:
If a sentence begins with [verb + ing] (gerund), the verb must also be singular.
Being cordial is one of his greatest assets.
Dieting is very popular today.
Source: Cliffs TOEFL, page no: 74

Daily Quiz.question: ১০) Henry _____ France in August.
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) is thinking to going to
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) is thinking of going to
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) is thinking of go to
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) is thinking to going in
Daily Quiz.exp:
prepositional phrase + verb + ing
Here, is thinking of = prepositional phrase; go+ing = verb+ing & “go” follows “to” preposition.
Source: Cliffs TOEFL, page no: 86

Daily Quiz.question: ১১) Could you tell me what time _____?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Auxiliary verb (could) + subject (you) +verb (tell) + question word (what) + subject (it) + verb (is).
Could you tell me what time it is? এর অর্থ এখন কয়টা বাজে আপনি কি আমাকে বলতে পারেন।
Source: Cliffs TOEFL, page no:95

Confusion removing explanation for choosing answer it is or it was:
"Could" is a modal verb used to express possibility or past ability as well as to make suggestions and requests.
In the sentence, “Could you tell me” expresses request, it doesn’t express possibility or past ability.
So, “Could you tell me” will follow a sentence which is “it is” (present tense).

Daily Quiz.question: ১২) Find out  the error segment of the following sentences (12 to 14). The food that Mark is cooking in the kitchen is smelling delicious.
Daily Quiz.exp:
It should be “smells”. Use the simple present tense for present time with stative (linking) verbs.
Source: Cliffs TOEFL, page no: 107 & 243

Daily Quiz.question: ১৩) After to take the medication, the patient became drowsy & more manageable.
Daily Quiz.exp:
Here “After to take” should be “After taking” & “to take” should be “taking”. Because both are wrong.
Use the gerund (verb+ing) after a preposition.
Source: Cliffs TOEFL, page no: 107 & 243

Daily Quiz.question: ১৪) There were a time that I used to swim five laps every day, but now I don't have enough time.
Daily Quiz.exp:
It should be “was”. The singular verb “was” agrees with singular subject “a time”
Source: Cliffs TOEFL, page no: 109 & 243

Daily Quiz.question: ১৫) Please _____ the necessity of arriving early.
Daily Quiz.exp:
The tendency is to assume that since the noun takes a preposition, the verb does as well.
This same tendency is at work in the use of "emphasise on" since the noun "emphasis" needs the preposition "on" but the verb "emphasise" ("emphasize") does not.
Source: Cambridge Dictionary

Daily Quiz.question: ১৬) Are you doing anything special ____ the weekend?
Daily Quiz.exp:
With particular points in the week:
What are you doing at the weekend?
Are you doing anything special at the weekend?
Source: Cambridge Dictionary

Daily Quiz.question: ১৭) Nazrul’s poems are instinct ____ revolution.
Daily Quiz.exp:
instinct for (naturally good at) = কোনো কিছুর প্রতি সহজাত প্রবৃত্তি।
Source: Cambridge Dictionary

Daily Quiz.question: ১৮) Technology has developed _____ great speed.
Daily Quiz.exp:
At great speed (very fast) = দ্রুত গতিতে।
Source: Cambridge Dictionary

Daily Quiz.question: ১৯) The principal had an inquiry ____ the administrative problem.
Daily Quiz.exp:
an inquiry into something (an official process to discover the facts about something bad that has happened) = কোন কিছুর তদন্ত।
Source: Cambridge Dictionary

Daily Quiz.question: ২০) May I come _____ Sir.
Daily Quiz.exp:
Come in (to enter a room or building): রুমের ভিতরে আসা।
Source: Cambridge Dictionary
